announcements.headline: EQS-News: SGL Carbon: Business performance in Q3 2026 supports an upward revision of the full-year earnings forecast
announcements.insight: An upward revision of full-year earnings signals strong operational execution in the carbon materials sector, likely driven by robust demand in energy storage and semiconductor applications, which serves as a positive catalyst for valuation multiples.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: SGL Carbon SE: Preliminary announcement of the publication of quarterly reports and quarterly/interim statements
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates the publication of scheduled quarterly financial reports, which provide shareholders with regular updates on the company's performance but do not specify the direction or magnitude of results.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: SGL Carbon sells its former Carbon Fiber facility in Moses Lake (USA)
announcements.insight: The disposal of a facility represents a material asset sale that may indicate strategic refocusing or capital recycling for shareholders. This type of transaction typically signals a shift in operational scope or financial structure.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: SGL Carbon SE reports preliminary sales and earnings figures for the first nine months and raises its forecast for 2026
announcements.insight: The upward revision of the 2026 forecast signals a structural recovery in the carbon materials sector, likely driven by sustained demand from the hydrogen economy and advanced manufacturing, distinguishing SGL from peers still grappling with cyclical headwinds.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: SGL Carbon: Still on track to meet its 2026 annual targets
announcements.insight: Confirms execution discipline on the turnaround plan within the carbon materials sector, mitigating near-term downside risk but lacking the catalyst for significant multiple expansion amidst broader industrial cyclicality.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: SGL Carbon SE: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the publication of financial reports as required by German securities law, indicating a scheduled regulatory filing rather than a specific operational update or performance result. Shareholders should refer to the full report for detailed financial data and strategic insights.
